**Thread 3:**

Super_Truffle_9821 -

Orange Julian

Redesigned

Your Weapons gain Damage equal to half the Gold you have gained this run.

So basically, it's half as effective as it was, but it's retroactive to all the money you've made the entire run, so you don't have to build it up. Orange Julian actually a viable buy in later days as opposed to now when if you don't get him by day 3-4 you almost never buy him.

veggie_blast -

Thank god! Weapons build felt like the lives or died on whether you found Julian/Figurehead early or not. At least now the item ain’t a dead draw.

allbreaker -

Yeah looks like they did this with all cash scaling items, cash cannon and monocle do the same

Smudgyo -

Seems like a straight up buff to cash cannon, and it was decent last patch too.

**Thread 4:**

topconfidential -

Mid to late game

The "gold you have gained this run" changes to Pyg items (cash cannon, monocle, oinkment) seem potentially really nuts, especially the changes to cash cannon. Granted, they did nerf Pyg's econ a bit this patch.

Bees might be a viable archetype again? The major bummer is that the redesign forces you to wait 2 days to get to 3 bees so you're basically holding 5 stash slots hostage until you can make the switch and then you have to have a big day of buying/selling property to make the switch worth it and you're still matchup dependent.

Notably beehive also can charge Beast of Burden and Cargo Shorts now.

Freeze got nerfed again? any property + diamond Snowglobe + diamond yo-yo + diamond piggles board now almost goes infinite. Booby Trap might be quite good in igloo builds - it solves the startup time issue that build has. The nerf to cold room hits heavy though. Snowmobile now fully charges in 2 freezes at every tier which might just make it good enough.
Early game

Crook and regal blade look dead to me. Dog looks viable again, though the chocolate event is gold now, so you'll rely on pitchfork. Maybe we see more dog/scarf builds again.

The tea set buff makes it so there's actually a reason to play burn Pyg again and so does the burn buff. Vanessa burn will still be far superior to it but at least it's a buff.

My prediction: weights are still going to be the premier early game line for Pyg. They were already very good and getting yo-yo down to silver makes it a lot stronger.
Misc

My favorite change is that shipment now gives non-Pyg items only. Yes ofc duping a yo-yo was fun but this is imho a better design. I just wish they removed loot items from the random small item pool. It feels so bad to get an event or shipment and get a loot item that sells for 2 regen.

456broom -

I see 5-6 buffs to pyg's eco and 3 nerfs. Overall I think his eco will be improved, and that with the persistent money gain mechanic to optimizing eco will be quite important even in runs where you haven't seen those sorts of items yet.

Crook looks terrible, regal blade looks okay. It's much less of a hard commit but you don't instantly win your early fights with it anymore.

I'm not convinced tea set changes are a buff. It certainly makes it work quite differently, but taking the burn off the item itself means you need either a matchbox or two other burn items to get a meaningfully better effect than before. I predict the item will still be mediocre and very niche, which is a terrible place for an item to be at - they really need to be somewhere on the range from broad and mediocre to niche and strong, where the more niche the item is the more powerful it can be.

topconfidential -

Wait which 5-6 econ buffs do you see? I just see business card and maybe dagger. Safe doesn't seem like a big buff - that item was money tree fodder and occasionally free money at Barkun. Pinata also isn't really econ, it's still net negative unless you have a pawnshop or dagger?
Landscraper, dagger, pawnshop, vineyard, gym all got nerfed for econ. I guess you can argue dagger to silver is a bigger buff than the nerf to its value scaling at diamond.

I think regal blade is properly dead. It winning you early fights was the main reason to pick it up early on and complete the quest. If it can't do that you're not picking it up early and that means you don't already have its quests somewhat completed by the time that hp and value scaling become relevant.

The major issue with tea set was that you needed to get it to gold for it to do anything - now it gives double the burn buff at silver. Yes you need the other burn items but you did before, too. I'm very positive this is a buff. It will play well with the redesigned Vineyard as well bc slow is really valuable for burn comps.

456broom -

Business card, safe, pinata, pawn shop, jabalian dagger, and crystal bonsai (this is the sketchy one that makes it 5-6 not just 6, the item is reliably better and that improves eco since it's an eco item, but not by much).

I think the gym change is not a big eco nerf since gym wasn't an eco item in the sense that you use it to net gain gold. You used it to gain max HP then cashed it in for some gold refund when you pivot off it. So it kinda matches up to the tiny bonsai eco buff.

Regal blade is just fine. It's less all in on that first quest, but the quest is easier to achieve and still provides a solid boost to winning early fights. Weaker than before but reasonably so.

Tea set only gives a better buff than before at silver if you have two other burn items or a matchbox, or another max HP gain item. I can't really see it boosting the other max HP gain items into a proper burn build synergy either since actually acquiring a tea set is difficult to target due to its typing. I will say hogwash at silver does present a potentially strong option for this though, and obviously it's quite good if you get hot stones and matchbox alongside it specifically. Tea set hogwash uwashiwali matchbox would be a pretty dirty lineup.

topconfidential -

Gotcha, so you're counting pawn shop being moved to bronze as a buff (the value scaling was nerfed). Pinata and safe are hardly making up for the nerf to top end econ scaling on pawn shop, land scraper and vineyard. They're hardly econ to begin with. I think this is an overall nerf to econ. For the purposes of the "gold you've gained this run" Pyg's gym nerf is pretty big. It allowed you to both gain a lot of HP while also making reasonable gold gains back. At gold it made every silver small effectively trade evenly. I guess you could make the same argument with dagger and the buff to pinata except that's not giving you HP on top. I do think you'll often buy dagger on day 2 or three now once you've set up most of your build.

I'm not going to convince you on regal blade it sounds like. We'll see.

You weren't playing tea set without at least two other burn items before anyways. If you were, you weren't winning many fights. You play tea set + hot stones + ladle &/ match box &/ fiery small item + succulent. That's the early build. I don't think you take this past the early mid game but you def have some more lines available now with hogwash + bird like you said and vineyard + heal/slow spam like I said.

**Thread 8:**

Sweet_Truffle_5829 -

Ok, is Beehive insane now or am I tripping? And Pawn Shop starting at bronze is going to make a lot of giant Pygs.

456broom -

Pawn shop starting at bronze with less value per sold item at higher ranks is going to make the item purely an eco item. It'll be too hard to stack high if you pick it up later, and early on you can't actually make enough sales for it to get big enough to be useful on board.

For it to match a mediocre bronze per slot value of 4 per slot second by the time the sandstorm arrives it would need 36 value. Even by the end of day two this would be exceptionally difficult to achieve.

The item will be purchased so that you get +1 gold per item sold until you have to cash it in, which will be good, but you won't see it on any boards unless the pyg screwed up finding a proper item to hold that slot.

Patch Preview: March 4
Patch 12.0: Enter the Hunter
SEASONAL UPDATES

    Prize Pass has been updated with the following free cosmetics:
        Level 20: Timerbline Glyph's Card Back
        Level 40: Talon Talent Karnok
    Chests
        The cosmetic chest graphics have been updated to be generic instead of Stelle themed
        The cosmetics from the previous Prize Pass has been added to the Chest
        Chests additions
            Boreal Guardian (Carpet)
            Owl and Squirrel (Carpet)
            30 Karnok item skins
    Store
        New Karnok cosmetics are now available for Gems in the Store

LEADERBOARD REWARDS

    Leaderboard Rewards have been given out to the following 1000 Players:
        Crash Site Champion (Top 10)
        Crash Site Paragon (Top 100)
        Crash Site Elite (Top 1000)

QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES

    Enchantments have been separated from item titles in tooltips
    While in windowed mode, players can now resize their window by dragging the edges or corners
    Videos can now be skipped by any keyboard input

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

    While not playing as Jules, you can now get Heated and Chilled Slots during Level Up, if you have an item that requires Heated or Chilled
        You can get a maximum of 1 of each of these
    While not playing as Karnok, you can now get Karnok’s basic Rage Skill during Level Up, if you have an item that requires Rage to function
    Slightly increased the Max HP Gained in the first 8 Levels (+50 each)
    Adjusted the way “Doubling” and other percentage-based triggered effects work so they no longer double dip with persistent percentage-based bonuses, for example:
        Obsidian Atlas Stone would more than double its damage on use, rather than double, because it’d take the buffed value to calculate the “double” buff, and when applied, this buff would then also be buffed by Obsidian’s doubling effect
        Similarly, Dishwasher and Fruit Press will no longer cause Fruit Press' damage to scale much higher than expected
    Persistent Percentage Max Health Gains now function additively
